t: Mirabel Avenue, between Coso and Mirabel Avenues, July 4, 1989, from 12:00 noon to 5:00 p.m.) Tuesday, Adopted .

This Board did declare that the damages, costs and expenses of closing said portion of Whipple avenue are nominal and no assessment district is necessary to be formed for the purpose of paying the damages, costs and expenses thereof…
pl: The city pays to close part of Whipple Avenue
